notes: Native-SAS port of the repo's calculate_sample_size routine (originally a %utl_pybegin scipy block, cross-checked with the R pwr package). Same alpha/power/effect_size inputs, same t_alpha/t_beta variables and 5-iteration refinement loop; SAS TINV/PROBIT stand in for scipy.stats.t.ppf. Produces n=64 per arm, matching the repo's documented Python and R output. No sample data needed (all inputs inline).
